---
title: "Public vs Private Visibility Rules"
---

# Public vs Private Visibility Rules
In Rust, **everything is private by default**. To expose items, use `pub`:
- `pub`: Public to everyone.
- `pub(crate)`: Visible within the current crate only.
- `pub(super)`: Visible to the parent module.

```rust
mod orders {
    pub struct Order {
        pub id: u64,
        secret_notes: String, // Private field!
    }

    impl Order {
        pub fn new(id: u64, notes: String) -> Self {
            Self { id, secret_notes: notes }
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let o = orders::Order::new(1, String::from("VIP customer"));
    println!("Order ID: {}", o.id);
    // println!("{}", o.secret_notes); // ERROR: private field
}
```
